title: Variable Pulse Generator
text: Generate ideal, time varying pulse signal, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Allow zero pulse width} allows zero magnitude of output signal, {Run at fixed time intervals} sets the continuous or discrete-time behavior and {Sampling rate} sets the pulse resolution. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Allow zero pulse width
params.values: Allow zero magnitude of output signal off (default) | on

params.name: Run at fixed time intervals
params.values: Choose continuous or discrete-time behavior continuous (default) | discrete
